note: S13: argv_floor.py became a mirror facade over argv_floor_self (the product's own subcommand floors and the credential-mint predicates), argv_floor_hosts (the names and addresses the ssh floor counts as this host), argv_floor_ssh (the ssh self-target floor) and argv_floor_git (release detection). It keeps its logger; every other public name it bound before the split is served from the owner that defines it.
